canonical_name: No Risk Appetite and Tolerance Statements
description: Risk appetite and tolerance statements are not established, communicated, and maintained.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for absence of risk appetite statements, undefined risk tolerance levels, missing communication channels for risk thresholds, lack of risk acceptance criteria.
